profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Waymo
profile.summary:
Software engineer with a passion for all things visual and fluid. I'm interested in making the user experience as rich and interactive as possible. 

Frameworks, Libraries and Platforms:
Android, iOS, Node.js

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Android Automotive
- Team Lead for Automotive Entertainment (Feb 2022 — Feb 2023)
- Team Lead for the Companion Device team (Jan 2019 — Feb 2022)
- Application developer for Android in the car. (Jan 2016 — Dec 2018)
- 2016 Google I/O demo: https://youtu.be/NgpjnW5Vj1I

Google+
- Android app development for Google+. (Jan 2014 — Dec 2015)

positions.title: Front End Engineer
positions.description:
One of the technical leads for the Yahoo Finance homepage redesign. Influenced common practices to use, such as common CSS and coding styles. Implemented base styles and utility classes.

- Client side markup and scripting.
- Work with both PHP and Node.js stack for middle-tier between API/storage layer and client.

positions.title: Quality Assurance
positions.description:
- In charge of data validation for ETL operations, as well as hands-on testing of software
- Automated testing by writing Perl scripts to read data from files and matching against database values
- Made use of change management review systems to document QA testing

positions.title: IS&T Intern
positions.description:
- Worked on solo project to design Java application to allow users to view their schedules in iCal.
- Wrote algorithm to properly resolve schedule information from databases, and utilized open source API to
store schedule in iCalendar file format.
- Wrote scheduled job to update databases with real-time data.
- Deployed application onto a WebLogic application server; verified functionality with load and unit testing
